spec.purpose: Explain a synthetic incident using reviewed pinned documentation
spec.instructions: Load both reviewed skills, read the requested reference and knowledge files, and cite exact source URLs. Explain proposed checks. State that this is documentation analysis and no operational investigation or changes were performed.
